exceptions.notFound: the requested order item was not found
exceptions.create: order item was not created successfuly, please contact the support team
exceptions.quantity-increase: order item's quantity was not increased successfuly, please contact the support team
exceptions.quantity-decrease: order item's quantity was not decreased successfuly, please contact the support team
exceptions.delete: order item was not deleted successfuly, please contact the support team
exceptions.finalized: the order items cannot be added, modified or deleted because the order is finalized
exceptions.exists: the product already exists in the order, if the quantity needs to be changed, please update the existing item
exceptions.min-quantity: the order item's quantity cannot be less than 1, if the item needs to be removed, please delete the item instead
